name: illustrious_xl_t2i
description: Illustrious XL v2.0 (SDXL anime checkpoint) text-to-image on the Comfy-Org 'SDXL simple' graph: checkpoint, two CLIPTextEncode, EmptyLatentImage, KSampler, VAEDecode. Sampler settings are the usual SDXL anime ones (the model card gives none). CreativeML OpenRAIL-M.

negative.default: worst quality, low quality, lowres, bad anatomy, bad hands, extra fingers, jpeg artifacts, watermark, signature, blurry

requires.assumed: euler_ancestral / normal / 28 steps / cfg 5.5 are a starting point, not from the model card; A/B on the server
